categories.name: Mandatory Requirements
categories.description: Required for QMS implementation and certification

clauses.title: Context of the Organization
clauses.description: Establishes the foundation by requiring organizations to understand their operating environment
clauses.helpText: Review strategic planning documents, SWOT analysis, stakeholder analysis

clauses.title: Understanding the organization and its context
clauses.description: The organization shall determine external and internal issues that are relevant to its purpose and its strategic direction and that affect its ability to achieve the intended result(s) of its quality management system
clauses.helpText: Document internal and external issues affecting QMS objectives

clauses.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
clauses.description: The organization shall determine the interested parties that are relevant to the QMS and their requirements
clauses.helpText: Identify stakeholders and document their needs and expectations

clauses.title: Determining the scope of the quality management system
clauses.description: The organization shall determine the boundaries and applicability of the QMS to establish its scope
clauses.helpText: Define QMS scope considering internal/external issues and interested parties

clauses.title: Quality management system and its processes
clauses.description: The organization shall establish, implement, maintain and continually improve a QMS, including the processes needed and their interactions
clauses.helpText: Document process flow, inputs, outputs, criteria, and monitoring methods

clauses.title: Leadership
clauses.description: Emphasizes top management's commitment and involvement in the QMS
clauses.helpText: Demonstrate leadership commitment through actions and resource allocation

clauses.title: Leadership and commitment
clauses.description: Top management shall demonstrate leadership and commitment with respect to the QMS
clauses.helpText: Evidence of management involvement in QMS activities and decisions

clauses.title: Policy
clauses.description: Top management shall establish, implement and maintain a quality policy
clauses.helpText: Quality policy should be appropriate, provide framework for objectives, and be communicated

clauses.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
clauses.description: Top management shall ensure that responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles are assigned, communicated and understood
clauses.helpText: Organization charts, job descriptions, and responsibility matrices

clauses.title: Planning
clauses.description: Focuses on actions to address risks and opportunities and setting quality objectives
clauses.helpText: Risk-based thinking integrated into planning processes

clauses.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
clauses.description: When planning for the QMS, the organization shall consider the issues and requirements and determine the risks and opportunities
clauses.helpText: Risk register, risk assessment methodology, and mitigation plans

clauses.title: Quality objectives and planning to achieve them
clauses.description: The organization shall establish quality objectives at relevant functions, levels and processes
clauses.helpText: SMART objectives (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound)

clauses.title: Planning of changes
clauses.description: When the organization determines the need for changes to the QMS, the changes shall be carried out in a planned manner
clauses.helpText: Change management process and documentation

clauses.title: Support
clauses.description: Ensures the provision of necessary resources for the QMS
clauses.helpText: Resources include people, infrastructure, environment, monitoring equipment, and knowledge

clauses.title: Resources
clauses.description: The organization shall determine and provide the resources needed for the establishment, implementation, maintenance and continual improvement of the QMS
clauses.helpText: Resource planning and allocation documentation

clauses.title: Competence
clauses.description: The organization shall determine the necessary competence of person(s) doing work under its control that affects the performance and effectiveness of the QMS
clauses.helpText: Training records, competency matrices, and qualification requirements

clauses.title: Awareness
clauses.description: The organization shall ensure that persons doing work under the organization's control are aware of the quality policy, relevant quality objectives, their contribution to the effectiveness of the QMS, and the implications of not conforming
clauses.helpText: Communication plans, training materials, and awareness campaigns

clauses.title: Communication
clauses.description: The organization shall determine the internal and external communications relevant to the QMS
clauses.helpText: Communication plan defining what, when, with whom, how, and who

clauses.title: Documented information
clauses.description: The organization's QMS shall include documented information required by this standard and documented information determined by the organization as being necessary for the effectiveness of the QMS
clauses.helpText: Document control procedures, records, and retention policies

clauses.title: Operation
clauses.description: Deals with operational planning and control of processes needed to meet requirements for products and services
clauses.helpText: Operational processes from customer requirements through delivery

clauses.title: Operational planning and control
clauses.description: The organization shall plan, implement and control the processes needed to meet the requirements for the provision of products and services
clauses.helpText: Process maps, work instructions, and control plans

clauses.title: Requirements for products and services
clauses.description: The organization shall ensure that customer requirements and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements are determined and met
clauses.helpText: Customer communication, contract review, and requirements documentation

clauses.title: Design and development of products and services
clauses.description: The organization shall establish, implement and maintain a design and development process
clauses.helpText: Design process, stages, reviews, verification, and validation (may be excluded if not applicable)

clauses.title: Control of externally provided processes, products and services
clauses.description: The organization shall ensure that externally provided processes, products and services conform to requirements
clauses.helpText: Supplier evaluation, approved supplier list, and purchasing procedures

clauses.title: Production and service provision
clauses.description: The organization shall implement production and service provision under controlled conditions
clauses.helpText: Production procedures, validation of processes, identification and traceability

clauses.title: Release of products and services
clauses.description: The organization shall implement planned arrangements at appropriate stages to verify that the product and service requirements have been met
clauses.helpText: Inspection and testing procedures, release criteria, and authorization

clauses.title: Control of nonconforming outputs
clauses.description: The organization shall ensure that outputs that do not conform to their requirements are identified and controlled to prevent their unintended use or delivery
clauses.helpText: Nonconformance handling procedures, segregation, and disposition

clauses.title: Performance Evaluation
clauses.description: Requires monitoring, measurement, analysis, and evaluation of the QMS
clauses.helpText: KPIs, metrics, internal audits, and management reviews

clauses.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
clauses.description: The organization shall determine what needs to be monitored and measured, the methods for monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation, and when the results shall be analysed and evaluated
clauses.helpText: Performance indicators, measurement methods, and analysis reports

clauses.title: Internal audit
clauses.description: The organization shall conduct internal audits at planned intervals to provide information on whether the QMS conforms to the organization's own requirements and to the requirements of this standard
clauses.helpText: Audit program, audit plans, competent auditors, and audit reports

clauses.title: Management review
clauses.description: Top management shall review the organization's QMS at planned intervals to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy, effectiveness and alignment with the strategic direction
clauses.helpText: Management review meetings, agenda items, and documented outcomes

clauses.title: Improvement
clauses.description: Focuses on continual improvement, nonconformity, and corrective action
clauses.helpText: Corrective actions, improvement initiatives, and effectiveness reviews

clauses.title: General improvement
clauses.description: The organization shall determine and select opportunities for improvement and implement any necessary actions to meet customer requirements and enhance customer satisfaction
clauses.helpText: Improvement projects, innovation processes, and results tracking

clauses.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
clauses.description: When a nonconformity occurs, the organization shall react to the nonconformity, evaluate the need for action to eliminate the causes, and implement any action needed
clauses.helpText: Corrective action procedure, root cause analysis, and effectiveness verification

clauses.title: Continual improvement
clauses.description: The organization shall continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the QMS
clauses.helpText: Improvement culture, analysis of results, and proactive enhancements
